patch.value: Promote improver policies from their own outcome ledger

Add a typed versioned proposal policy, ledger-driven successor updates, equal-budget meta-task promotion, durable resume, and a three-generation CPU experiment over public tracker histories with two prediction targets.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Plan: retain the existing statistical promotion gate; add content-addressed finite search arms with Bayesian outcome priors, update candidates from development-only ledger outcomes, compare proposal policies on disjoint meta trackers under identical fit budgets, and open final audit trackers only after selection. Prediction features use strictly earlier history; chronological splits purge labels unavailable at their boundary. Record three generations, baselines, confidence bounds, actual kill/resume and behavioral revert proofs. Canonical sources remain read-only; dependency pins and thresholds remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented two independent artifact levels: learner fits use the existing reserved process adapter and unchanged statistical gate; proposer artifacts contain bounded feature/optimizer arms with explicit outcome priors. Candidate priors are rebuilt from unique development-only proposal receipts. Meta challengers start from the same constant learner and receive identical candidate counts and optimizer updates. Confidence is allocated over planned comparisons; meta sample size is distinct trackers, averaging the related targets within each tracker. A frozen audit role remains unopened until all generations finish.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Added bounded in-flight recovery: every logical fit has at most two predeclared process slots, each launched at most once. A SIGKILL after a persisted launch intent with a missing or partially written completion can consume the second slot with identical training data and source parameters; the first failed reservation and conservative charge remain audited. Complete invalid receipts refuse, cancellation does not retry, and exhausting both attempts cannot allocate a third. The real SDK/OS test passes 1/1 across missing, partial, invalid, cancellation, trainer-failure and storage-fault scenarios. Normal 34-fit runs still perform 8704 SGD updates; recovery capacity is capped at 68 process jobs and 17408 updates within the unchanged whole-run deadline. Both meta contenders receive that same cap.
